comment:
* Layout parameters that should be supplied for views added to a
     * ViewPager.

variables.name: isDecor
variables.comment:
* true if this view is a decoration on the pager itself and not
         * a view supplied by the adapter.

variables.name: gravity
variables.comment:
* Gravity setting for use on decor views only:
         * Where to position the view page within the overall ViewPager
         * container; constants are defined in {@link android.view.Gravity}.

variables.name: widthFactor
variables.comment: * Width as a 0-1 multiplier of the measured pager width

variables.name: needsMeasure
variables.comment:
* true if this view was added during layout and needs to be measured
         * before being positioned.

variables.name: position
variables.comment: * Adapter position this view is for if !isDecor

variables.name: childIndex
variables.comment: * Current child index within the ViewPager that this view occupies
